[[File:DJ Leo.png|thumb|250px|DJ Leo]] '''DJ Leo''' (Japanese: '''DJレオ''' ''DJ Leo''), whose real name is simply '''Leo''' (Japanese: '''レオ''' ''Leo''), is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. He is a childhood friend of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and a [[DJ]], who is a part of the DJ group '''Dig-Dug-Leo''' (Japanese: '''ディグダグレオ''' ''Dig-Dug-Leo''), previously called '''Dug-Leo''' (Japanese: '''ダグレオ''' ''Dug-Leo'') before the {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Diglett}} joined him and his Alolan {{p|Dugtrio}}. ==History== [[File:Young DJ Leo.png|thumb|left|250px|DJ Leo before he met Dugtrio]] DJ Leo debuted in ''[[SM023|Getting the Band Back Together!]]'', where {{an|Professor Kukui}}, {{Ash}}, and {{ashcl}} took [[Mimo]] to her first concert. While returning home, they encountered Leo, who recognized Kukui from his school days and invited them back to his place. An {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Diglett}} also attended, showcasing its singing talents, though this only irritated Leo's star Alolan {{p|Dugtrio}}. {{TRT}}, [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|disguised as talent agents]], offered Dugtrio the opportunity to pursue a solo career, which it accepted. Consequently, Dug-Leo officially split from Dugtrio, putting their upcoming concert in jeopardy. After hearing the news, Ash and friends rushed over to Leo's and offered to find Dugtrio. They tracked it down to the mountains and went on to defeat Team Rocket. Now with the addition of Diglett, Leo renamed the DJ group to "Dig-Dug-Leo". In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', DJ Leo attended the wedding of Professor Kukui and {{an|Professor Burnet}} and provided the music for the event. In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', DJ Leo was seen after Ash and {{ashcl}} entered the battlefield on [[Manalo Stadium]] before the [[Manalo Conference]] began. DJ Leo was later among the 151 {{pkmn|Trainer}}s taking part in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round, where he entered with his Alolan Dugtrio, but was defeated. ==Character== Leo is easygoing and the epitome of coolness. He originally began writing folk music about [[Alola]]'s natural beauty, though his collaboration with {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Dugtrio}} and {{p|Diglett}} prompted him to transition to {{wp|electropop}}. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of DJ Leo's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=DJ Leo |pkmn=Dugtrio |nick=Jessica, Ashley, and Michael |type1=Ground |type2=Steel |img=DJ Leo Dugtrio.png |epnum=SM023 |epname=Getting the Band Back Together! |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vajpnote=Jessica |vaen=Marc Thompson |vaennote=Ashley, Michael |vaen2=Erica Schroeder |vaen2note=Jessica |desc=Leo encountered this {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Dugtrio}} after hearing it singing in a forest. Impressed with its vocal range, he decided to form a DJ duo with it, called Dug-Leo, which was later renamed Dig-Dug-Leo. The Dugtrio heads are each called, '''Jessica''' (Japanese: '''ジェシカ''' ''Jessica''), '''Ashley''' (Japanese: '''アシュリー''' ''Ashley''), and '''Michael''' (Japanese: '''マイケル''' ''Michael''). DJ Leo fans often attend his concerts wearing blonde wigs inspired by Alolan Dugtrio's signature hairstyles. In ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', Dugtrio attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet}} with DJ Leo. In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', DJ Leo used Dugtrio in the [[Manalo Conference]] preliminary round [[Battle Royal]], but they failed to reach the Top 16. Dugtrio's known moves are {{m|Tri Attack}} and {{m|Iron Head}}, and its Ability is {{a|Tangling Hair}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=DJ Leo |pkmn=Diglett |type1=Ground |type2=Steel |img=DJ Leo Diglett.png |epnum=SM023 |epname=Getting the Band Back Together! |vajp= |vaen=Sarah Natochenny |desc=This {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Diglett}} appeared at Leo's after he and his Alolan Dugtrio performed a show on [[Melemele Island]]. This Diglett is a great fan of DJ Leo's Dugtrio, and became its apprentice after singing for it. It joined DJ Leo and the Dugtrio in the new group, named Dig-Dug-Leo. It appeared again in ''[[SM055|The Professors' New Adventure!]]'', where it attended the wedding of {{an|Professor Kukui}} and {{an|Professor Burnet}} with DJ Leo.
